annotations.title: Look up a registered migration agent

description: Use this to check whether a person appears as a currently registered migration agent, by name or MARN (Migration Agents Registration Number), and to find the agency they work at. Returns up to 8 matches with MARN and agency profile URL. This is our copy of the OMARA register, not a live check; always point users to the OMARA register to confirm.

query.description: Agent name (e.g. Jane Citizen) or MARN (e.g. 1234567).

name: find_registered_agent
